text: Useful NMAP Command with OS Fingerprinting nmap -sV -0 -sC --top-ports 100 -T4 -oA [file] [address] nmap -sV -O -sC --top-ports 100 -T4 -oA out.txt 10.1.1.0/24 2 -sV -Probe open ports to determine service-/version info -0 -Enable OS detection -sC -Enable Script scanning --top-ports -Only scan “popular ports” -T4 -Sets template for fast scans (0 slow — 5 fast) -oA -Output file
